title: Doomsday 2048: Weapon Fusion Minigame | Home Utilities
description: Merge ammo, pistols, submachine guns, and rotary Gatling cannons in this Doomsday: Last Survivors themed 2048 mini webgame.

translations.text: Slide and merge matching bullets, sidearms, submachine guns, and Gatling cannons to craft ultimate high-tier apocalyptic firepower. Can you forge the Tier 11 Dual Vulcan Minigun and the legendary Tier 12 Triple Gatling Overlord?
Merge 9mm bullets into heavy artillery. Play with arrow keys, WASD, on-screen controls, or swipe gestures on touchscreens.
Merge matching weapons together to advance tiers and boost your combat score.
Swipe or use Arrow Keys to merge weapons and upgrade your arsenal!
Complete 12-Tier Weapon Evolution from 9mm round to Triple Gatling Overlord.
